verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing says it helps you "declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI" (featurebase-docs-7). That is a direct but thin claim of AI-derived insight from feedback data inside the product. The other AI features, the Fibi support agent (featurebase-docs-10) and AI search answers (featurebase-docs-14), are customer-facing support tools rather than insights for the user, and the Reports analytics (featurebase-docs-25) are not described as AI-generated. Missing for 10: documentation of what AI insights or suggestions are generated and from which data (e.g. feedback clustering, prioritization recommendations, summaries), how they surface in the dashboard, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
